Fizz.gap_summary: Module prices W's ACTIVE empower only ('Active trident damage rides the next basic attack; passive bleed and post-kill refund remain explicit state'). The W PASSIVE rend — wiki: 'Fizz's basic attacks rend enemies on-hit, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits' (FizzW/FizzWAttack damage.on-hit + damage.dot atoms) — is real champion-target on-hit damage that the module does not price, so Fizz's auto stream understates sustained damage. The exclusion is documented ('not silently applied to champions') but it is a damage-relevant mechanic, not pure sustain/utility, so a human should decide whether the passive rend belongs in scope.
